title: C^r inverse function theorem with a C^r local inverse on an open target
statement: Let d, r ∈ ℕ with r ≥ 1, let V ⊆ ℝ^d be open, z₀ ∈ V, and let φ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d be of class C^r on V with Dφ(z₀) = fderiv ℝ φ z₀ injective. Then there are open sets V₀, O ⊆ ℝ^d and a map χ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d such that z₀ ∈ V₀ ⊆ V, χ is of class C^r on O, χ maps O into V₀, φ(χ(a)) = a for every a ∈ O, and φ(z) ∈ O and χ(φ(z)) = z for every z ∈ V₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (d r : ℕ) (φ : Euclid d → Euclid d) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (z₀ : Euclid d), 1 ≤ r → IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ r φ V → Injective (fderiv ℝ φ z₀) → ∃ (V₀ O : Set (Euclid d)) (χ : Euclid d → Euclid d), IsOpen V₀ ∧ IsOpen O ∧ z₀ ∈ V₀ ∧ V₀ ⊆ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ r χ O ∧ MapsTo χ O V₀ ∧ (∀ a ∈ O, φ (χ a) = a) ∧ ∀ z ∈ V₀, φ z ∈ O ∧ χ (φ z) = z
